therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Radium-223 plus androgen receptor blocker (enzalutamide or darolutamide)
therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: Alpha particle radiation to bone metastases plus androgen receptor
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Alpha particle radiation targeting bone metastases combined with androgen receptor blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Bone metastasis control and androgen signaling inhibition

safety_signals: Bone fractures (1 participant in radium-223 group)
results.dose_information: 12-week lead-in period with ARB followed by randomization to radium-223 or placebo
